notes: Full audit of every deliverable rendering TAM recommendations, as requested after the 5.6.12 account-scoping fix. Found the 'N of your systems' rescoping fell back to a category-wide risk count whenever a recommendation's subCategory didn't exactly match a risk subCategory string -- true for every Best Practices check -- so every card in that category showed the same fabricated count (e.g. '162 of your 171') regardless of that card's own, very different score. Also fixed a related bug: a recommendation with a genuine 0% problem rate displayed as 'Score: 0%' (total failure) instead of the correct 100% all-clear. Both are now derived directly from the already-normalized health score (exact by construction), fixed identically across the on-screen tab, the Section 12 TXT export (previously no correction at all), and the QBR Pack deliverable (previously a vague '[see scoped count]' placeholder). Verified live: four checks (43%/63%/87%/99%) that all showed '162 of your 171' now correctly show 97, 63, 22, and 2 -- across all three surfaces.
